title: Emily Feng on the Uyghurs, Syria and Xinjiang - The Wire China
gist: A Q&A-style item introducing journalist Emily Feng (NPR White House correspondent, former China correspondent and Financial Times Beijing reporter) as the guest on the Uyghurs, Syria and Xinjiang. Only the teaser, mostly her biography, is available (paywalled).

insights.claim: Emily Feng is NPR's White House correspondent and previously covered China and Taiwan as a foreign correspondent for NPR and reported from Beijing for the Financial Times.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Context only: the substantive discussion of Uyghurs, Syria and Xinjiang is behind the paywall.
